name: PRTGaussian
definition: A relighting framework that combines 3D Gaussian Splatting and Precomputed Radiance Transfer to achieve efficient and high-quality relighting using multi-view OLAT data.
summary: PRTGaussian is a real-time relightable novel-view synthesis method that combines 3D Gaussian Splatting with Precomputed Radiance Transfer for efficient, high-quality relighting of diffuse materials.
